questions.prompt: The first line missing from the broken portfolio page (the browser enters quirks mode without it). Type it exactly:
questions.explain: `<!DOCTYPE html>` — the HTML5 doctype must be the FIRST line; without it the browser enters **quirks mode**. Also commonly missing: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">` for responsive scaling.

questions.prompt: Where must `<caption>` sit in a table, and what does `colspan="2"` do?
options: First child of <table>, renders above it · merges a cell across two columns
Last child of <table> · spans two rows
questions.explain: `<caption>` must be the **first child of `<table>`** (renders above). `colspan="2"` merges the Total label across the first two columns. Don't forget `<tbody>` and `scope="row"` for row headers.

questions.prompt: The lab sets html `font-size: 62.5%`. With browser default 16px, what is 1rem in pixels? (number only)
questions.explain: 62.5% of 16px = **10px**, so 1rem = 10px — easy mental math (1.6rem = 16px etc.).

questions.prompt: The nav must stick to the viewport top while scrolling, with logo and links pushed to opposite ends. Which pair?
questions.explain: `position: sticky` + `top: 0` pins the nav while scrolling. The nav is a flex container; `justify-content: space-between` pushes logo and link list to opposite ends of the main axis.

questions.prompt: The lab BANS innerHTML for building cards. Which trio is the approved pattern?
questions.explain: **createElement** (build), **textContent** (safe text — no HTML parsing, no XSS), **appendChild** (insert). `setAttribute('data-id', …)` stamps the id so event delegation can find the note later.

questions.prompt: Before deleting a note, the lab requires a blocking OK/Cancel dialog, then removing ONE array element at the found index. Which calls?
questions.explain: `confirm` returns true (OK) / false (Cancel) — the gate before destructive action. `findIndex` gives the position (or −1). `splice(index, 1)` removes exactly one element (mutates). `slice` would COPY, not remove.

questions.prompt: Event delegation in the tasks lab works by:
options: ONE listener on the parent list; clicks bubble up; read data-action/data-id off the clicked element; guard if either is missing
One listener per button, re-attached on every render
A global window.onclick that scans the whole DOM
questions.explain: One `addEventListener` on the parent — clicks **bubble** up. `getAttribute('data-action')` + `parseInt(idStr, 10)`, with the guard `if (!action || !idStr) return;` to ignore non-button clicks. This is exactly why listeners don't go inside renderNotes().

questions.prompt: Which BOM members report viewport width and browser identification?
questions.explain: **window.innerWidth/innerHeight** = viewport px (re-read on `window.addEventListener('resize', …)`). **navigator.userAgent** = browser id string. Modern key check: `e.key === "Enter"` (replaces keyCode 13).
